boundaries.description: After using a technique or counterattack, the critical rate of the special attack increases by 30% for 6 seconds, and can be stacked up to 2 times. Each time a special attack lands a critical hit, the cooldown of the technique is reduced by 0.5 seconds. This activates once every 0.5 seconds.
boundaries.name: Sun That Seals the Sky

boundaries.description: Increases Getsuga Mark duration by 3 seconds. Each time Ichigo hits an enemy affected by Getsuga Mark, all damage dealt by him increases by 3% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. When Ichigo is in the Hollowfied state, can be stacked up to 10 times.
boundaries.name: Rising Black Moon

Increases Level of Basic Attack, Technique, Ultimate and Counterattack by 2.

skills.description:
Ichigo strikes 5 times with Tensa Zangetsu, dealing damage qual to 617.5% of ATK and gaining Spiritual Pressure. 
 Stop attacking after the 3rd strike, and Ichigo will charge briefly. When a glow appears, tap the Basic Attack button to release a special attack. ~~Tenbu Renjin~~ Ichigo slashes 6 times in rapid succession, dealing damage equal to 447.5% of ATK. ~~Hollowfication - Super High-speed Slash~~ Hollowfied 
 Increases the total DMG of the 5 basic attacks to 917.5%. Increase the total DMG of the special attack Tenbu Renjin to 665%.
skills.name: Super High-speed Slash

skills.description:
Ichigo release a dark sword wave that strikes the target from afar, dealing DMG equal to 580% of ATK and inflicting 1 stack of Getsuga Mark for 5s. 
 Tap the basic attack button when the technique hits the enemy, and Ichigo will dash to them and release a special attack. ~~Hollowfication - Getsugatensho~~ Hollowfied 
 After Hollowfication, Ichigo releases a Getsuga Tensho twice in a row, dealing DMG equal to 870% of ATK with the first attack and 870% of ATK with the second.
skills.name: Getsuga Tensho

skills.description:
Ichigo releases his Hollow powers to immediately release a counterattack, reset his technique cooldown, and get Hollowfied for 10s. 
 During this time, Ichigo gains the following effects: he is harder to interrupt, has greatly increased DMG, is able to release techniques twice in a row, his HP won't drop below 1, and his Ultimate is replaced with Deathblow. ~~Deathblow~~ Release again while Hollowfied 
 Ichigo releases dark Getsuga Tensho infused with the Force of Hollow, dealing 1242.5% damage to the target. Getsuga Tensho then explodes, dealing 3750% damage to all enemies in range. This skill can only be released once while under the Hollowfied state. If not manually released during the Hollowfied state, it will automatically trigger when the Hollowfied state ends.
skills.name: Hollowfication

skills.description:
After dodging an enemy attack, Ichigo performs a rapid counterattack with Tensa Zangetsu, dealing 1262.5% damage and launching the attacker. 
 The final strike of the counterattack inflicts 1 stack of Getsuga Mark on the target. Tap the Basic Attack button to instantly follow up with a special attack. 
 While releasing the skill, Ichigo gains Invincibility. ~~Hollowfication - Counter~~ Hollowfied 
 After dodging an enemy attack, Ichigo performs a rapid counterattack with Tensa Zangetsu, dealing 1262.5% damage and launching the attacker. 
 The final strike of the counterattack inflicts 1 stack of Getsuga Mark on the target. Tap the Basic Attack button to instantly follow up with a special attack. 
 While releasing the skill, Ichigo gains Invincibility.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Ichigo gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Flash Step
